subject: Biochemistry
vignette: A 32-year-old man has fasted for 3 days during a religious observance. His liver is oxidizing fatty acids at a high rate, supplying acetyl-CoA for energy and ketone body production.
question: Which of the following sets of products is generated in the mitochondrial matrix during a single cycle of beta-oxidation of a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA?
explanation_correct: One beta-oxidation cycle releases one acetyl-CoA and one shortened acyl-CoA, and its four reactions generate one FADH2 through acyl-CoA dehydrogenase and one NADH through 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase. The acetyl-CoA can enter the TCA cycle or be used for ketogenesis, while the reduced cofactors donate electrons to the respiratory chain.

explanation_incorrect.A: NADPH is not produced by beta-oxidation; NADPH is used in reductive synthesis.
explanation_incorrect.B: Propionyl-CoA is produced only from odd-chain fatty acids in the final cycle, not during each cycle of a long-chain acyl-CoA.
explanation_incorrect.C: NADPH is not generated by beta-oxidation; the dehydrogenase step produces NADH.
explanation_incorrect.D: Malonyl-CoA is an intermediate of fatty acid synthesis and is not produced during beta-oxidation.

educationalObjective: Each round of beta-oxidation yields acetyl-CoA, NADH, and FADH2.
